title: Growableores Agritech (AT2) compatibility
description: Compatibility Datapack for Growableores to be able to grow in Agritech AT2 planters.
body:
Compatibility Datapack for Growableores to be able to grow in Agritech (AT2) planters.
Shared to save others trouble, if mod authors don't want it, feel free to take it down.
If you are one of the mod authors please add support so that this datapack is not needed. <3

Original mods:
[GrowableOres](https://modrinth.com/mod/growableores) 
[Agritech (AT2)](https://modrinth.com/mod/agritech)
